title: UV-Box Decontamination Chambers
meta_title: UV-Box Decontamination Chambers | High-Efficiency UV Disinfection
meta_description: The UV-Box Decontamination Chamber is a high-efficiency tunnel enclosure designed to safely decontaminate masks and other small items using high-intensity UV Surround Technology.
meta_keywords: uv box, decontamination chamber, uv disinfection, mask decontamination, high-efficiency uv
short_description: UV-Box Decontamination Chamber is a high-efficiency tunnel enclosure, engineered for easy loading and high throughput, designed to create light emission conditions known to safely decontaminate masks and other small items. High intensity UV Surround Technology destroys exposed surface viruses and bacteria while providing for a safe work environment for the operator.
full_description: Eight 254 nm UV lamps surrounding the grated loading tray create light emission conditions known to destroy exposed viruses and bacteria on items placed within the chamber. Microprocessor control with color viewscreen provides programming capabilities, status and safety functions. A tray interlock interrupts operation in the event of an accidental opening. Both HEPA and activated carbon filters capture pathogens and vapors emitted as a byproduct of decontamination, protecting the user and the environment.
seo_content: The UV-Box Decontamination Chamber is designed for high-throughput decontamination of masks, personal protective equipment, and other small items. Its high-intensity UV Surround Technology effectively destroys exposed surface viruses and bacteria, while advanced safety features and filtration systems protect users and the environment. With programmable microprocessor controls and a compact desktop design, the UV-Box is an efficient and versatile solution for a wide range of decontamination applications.
